description: This file contains test cases for the ChatLog component, verifying its behavior in managing system, user, assistant, and tool messages, as well as handling state related to message overflow, pruning, and inline inline display of BTW information.

classes.name: ChatLog
classes.description: The ChatLog class manages chat message entries, handling addition, pruning, rendering, and state management for system, user, assistant, and tool messages, including inline BTW displays.

methods.name: addSystem
methods.description: Adds a system message to the chat log.

methods.name: startAssistant
methods.description: Begins an assistant message flow with specified name and run ID.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Adds a user message to the chat log.

methods.name: showBtw
methods.description: Displays a BTW message inline in the chat log.

methods.name: addPendingUser
methods.description: Adds a pending user message with optional timestamp.

methods.name: restorePendingUsers
methods.description: Restores pending user messages after a history rebuild.

methods.name: commitPendingUser
methods.description: Marks a pending user message as committed.

methods.name: reconcilePendingUsers
methods.description: Reconciles pending user messages against a list of external messages using timestamps.

methods.name: countPendingUsers
methods.description: Returns the number of pending user messages.

methods.name: hasVisibleBtw
methods.description: Checks if a BTW message is currently visible.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears all messages, with optional preservation of pending users.

methods.name: updateAssistant
methods.description: Updates an assistant message with a given run ID.

methods.name: updateToolResult
methods.description: Updates a tool message with provided result content.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the current chat log, with a specified timeout or display parameter.
